newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan says India increasing tension.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan says India increasing tension.

text.p: Pakistani Foreign Minister Gohar Ayub Khan accused India on Thursday of increasing tension ahead of planned peace talks between the two rival neighbours.
At a news conference he cited a recent alleged violation of Pakistani airspace, deployment of medium-range ballistic missiles near the border and a border clash on Tuesday night.

"Mixed signals are coming from New Delhi," Khan said in an apparent reference to New Delhi's desire to attend a planned second meeting in Islamabad between top Indian and Pakistani foreign ministry officials after the two sides resumed talks in March following a three-year hiatus.
He said at a news conference the Indian military acts had "unnecessarily created tension".

"They have not helped the negotiations," he said.
